title: Unique Bodied Attorney Andre Barnes In Raising Kanan S4 E2
htmlContent:
The stakes are raised in Season 4, Episode 2 of Power Book III: Raising Kanan. The final scene is filled with shocking moments as Unique takes matters into his own hands, literally and fatally, against Raquel Thomas's attorney, Andre Barnes.

A Fatal Confrontation

Despite years of tension between Unique and Raq, this episode demonstrates that the former rival-turned-occasional ally is still unbreakable. As the episode nears its climax, Unique sees Andre Barnes, Raq's top attorney, and immediately questions his loyalty. “So you fսck¡n’ her?” Unique demands, his words dripping with suspicion and menace. Before Andre can fully process the weight of the accusation, Unique launches a brutal attack, pummeling him with fists before delivering the chilling truth: “'Cause if you fսck¡n' her… you could be damn sure she fսck¡n' you, n****.” Unique doesn't hesitate to shoot Barnes in cold blood, leaving another body in the wake of Raq's powerful moves.

What This Means for Raq and Unique

The absence of Andre Barnes leaves Raq vulnerable and exposed in an already chaotic world. Unique has just sent an unmistakable message that he still has the power to control the game, even if Raq seems to be making the moves. Raising Kanan Season 4 is made more unpredictable by this explosive moment, proving that no one is truly safe in the Power Universe.
